question: What was the rank of India in the final medals tally of Commonwealth Games 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Third**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• India finished with** 3rd rank** in 2018, with **28 gold.**
 
• India won a total of** 66 medals including 26 gold,20 silver and 20 bronze**.
 
• Table tennis sensation **Manika Batra was** India best athlete at the gold coasts games winning** 4 medals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• About commonwealth game
 
 
• The Games aim to unite the Commonwealth family through a glorious festival of sport
 
• The event was** first held in 1930.**
 
• The Commonwealth is a voluntary association of** 54 independent countries**
 
• The origins of the Commonwealth come from Britain's former Empire
 
• Burma (also known as Myanmar) and Aden (now part of the Republic of Yemen) are the only states that were British colonies at the time of the war not to have joined the Commonwealth upon independence
 
• ** India and Pakistan were granted independence in 1947**, they became members of the Commonwealth
 
 

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• Most medal in the commonwealth country name is** Australia Gold 963 **Silver 795 Bronze 729.
 
• Most medal rank India rank is** 4th** ** Gold **184 Silver 176 Bronze 152.
 
• The next commonwealth game on 2022, the hosted country name is **Birmingham England.**
